changes: Unified macOS, Windows and script release; same accepted .14 camera payload and .22 executable logic, updated installer metadata only
Allow verified owned driver packages to retire absent instances with matching hardware after changing USB ports; additional live devices and different hardware still block removal
Use POSIX ancestry for camera directory commands on all hosts; fixes WindowsPath root loop before install/uninstall backup
Match Windows USB user API to installed driver; direct libusb0.dll avoids requiring an unbundled libusbK.dll bridge
Follow a verified same-serial ILCE-7C normal USB PID change after driver installation; keep both per-interface recovery records and bound retries to3
Initial-window check-fast uses a 1-second total timeout; ordinary check retains 4 seconds, transfers unchanged
New Wi-Fi interfaces use a bounded 10-second fast recovery window rather than two attempts; record check result/start/end timestamps; normal idle remains cached
One bounded FTP check at startup and Wi-Fi device-generation changes; error indicator, capped backoff and recovery clear; no idle FTP heartbeat
Replace BOOTTIME-only wake hint: Sony standby freezes system clocks; sampler observes wlan0 ifindex and worker retains its previous value across waits
Use negotiated USB current_speed rather than stale configured state; publish cached health after delayed native owner binding
Wait for USB gadget disconnection before native SD receipt/media access; keep the service alive while USB is attached
Reuse <=8s drive/directory for pre-copy check; refresh complete recording state and current card/open handles
Source-not-ready uses short retry instead of network exponential backoff
Remove fixed 1s wait between successful backlog uploads
Install starts service by default and verifies upload initialization and live native display
Desktop connection, installed state, inline FTP result and timestamped runtime log improvements
Detect already-retired renderer before reinitializing; report restart required instead of attempting one-shot native init twice
